place.name: Bahia
place.description: Bahia (English: , bə-(H)EE-ə; Brazilian Portuguese: [baˈi.ɐ] ) is one of the 26 states of Brazil, located in the Northeast Region of the country. It is the fourth-largest Brazilian state by population (after São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro) and the 5th-largest by area.
